title: A descended source with compatible quotient maps yields the formal comparisons and arrow.
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ a coherent module and $N$ a coherent formal module for $J$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $\delta:N\to H^\wedge$. Let $(U_i)$ be a family of open subschemes. Assume the opens cover $X$. Supply coherent $H_i=H|_{U_i}$, coherent $F_i$, arrows $a_i:F_i\to H_i$, and $\beta_i:N|_{U_i}\cong F_i^\wedge$. Supply over-site representatives $L_i$ identified with $F_i$, maps $b_i$ corresponding to $a_i$, and $q_{i,n}$ corresponding to $\pi_{F_i,n}\beta_{i,n}^{-1}$, satisfying $q_{i,n}\delta_n=b_i\pi_{H,n}$. Supply transitions $\theta_{ij}$ compatible with $b_i,q_{i,n}$, and an already glued global module $M$ with isomorphisms $\varphi_i:M|_{U_i}\cong L_i$ respecting the transitions. Then $M$ is coherent, there is $a:M\to H$, and there are local system isomorphisms $\epsilon_i:N|_{U_i}\cong M^\wedge|_{U_i}$ agreeing on contained opens and satisfying $\delta_n|_{U_i}=\epsilon_{i,n}a^\wedge_n|_{U_i}$. There are $e_i:M|_{U_i}\cong F_i$ intertwining $a$ with $a_i$ after the supplied identification of $H_i$.

source.place: Tag 0889(1), first sentence of the proof (Zariski locality via uniqueness); Sheaves Tags 00AL and 00AM

proof.text: Define e_i as overFunctorEquiv.inv at M, followed by overEquiv.mapIso(phi_i) and l_i. Transport coherence from F_i through e_i.symm using the final public isomorphism-invariance clause of coherent_kernel_cokernel_sum. This public interface works through the upstream-sync re-export wrapper. Apply coherence locality on the given cover to obtain hM.

The local arrows phi_i.hom followed by b_i agree componentwise: substitute hbcompat and then hphi, using associativity. Apply the proved private module_hom_gluing_exists helper of GlueSheavesOfModules to obtain a0 with a0.over(U_i)=phi_i.hom followed by b_i. Bundle it as an arrow a from the coherent M to H. Only morphism gluing is used; the object descent clause is unnecessary because M is supplied.

Set p_i,n=phi_i.hom followed by q_i,n. Functoriality, hqi and cancellation of overFunctorEquiv.hom with its inverse establish the normalized quotient equation hpi. Associativity, hqcompat and hphi establish overlap agreement. The restriction equation for a0 and hdelta establish p_i,n followed by delta_n = a.over(U_i) followed by the quotient projection.

Apply compatible_quotient_formal_comparisons with the coherent source M, arrow a, isomorphisms e_i and maps p_i,n. It gives epsilon, its overlap equality and the completion factorization. Naturality of overFunctorEquiv, the restriction equation for a0, and hbi prove the remaining intertwining equation after cancellation of overFunctorEquiv.hom. Pair these conclusions.

theorem torsionControlled_descended_source_comparisons
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤)
    (Hlocal : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (hHlocal : ∀ i, (Hlocal i).obj = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj H.obj)
    (Fi : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (ai : ∀ i, Fi i ⟶ Hlocal i)
    (βi : ∀ i, N.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) (Fi i).obj)
    (Li : ∀ i, SheafOfModules ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (U i)))
    (li : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.obj (Li i) ≅ (Fi i).obj)
    (bi : ∀ i, Li i ⟶ H.obj.over (U i))
    (qi : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), Li i ⟶ (N.obj.obj n).over (U i))
    (θ : ∀ i j,
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U i)).obj (Li i) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U j)).obj (Li j))
    (hbi : (∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map (bi i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app H.obj ≫
          eqToHom (hHlocal i).symm = (li i).hom ≫ (ai i).hom))
    (hqi : (∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map (qi i n) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app (N.obj.obj n) =
          (li i).hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap (U i).ι) (n.unop + 1) (Fi i).obj ≫
            (βi i).inv.app n))
    (hδ : (∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), qi i n ≫ (δ.hom.app n).over (U i) =
        bi i ≫ (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n.unop + 1) H.obj).over (U i)))
    (hbcompat : (∀ (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
        (θ i j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)))) ≫
          (bi j).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj))) =
            (bi i).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi)))))
    (hqcompat : (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
        (θ i j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)))) ≫
          (qi j n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj))) =
            (qi i n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi)))))
    (M : X.Modules) (φ : ∀ i, M.over (U i) ≅ Li i)
    (hφ : ∀ (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
      (φ i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) ≫
        (θ i j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)))) =
          (φ j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj)))) :
    ∃ (hM : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace M),
    ∃ (a : (⟨M, hM⟩ : CoherentModules X) ⟶ H)
      (ε : ∀ i, N.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (U i) ≅
        ((completion X J).obj ⟨M, hM⟩).obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (U i)),
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j),
        ((ε i).hom.app n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hi))) =
          ((ε j).hom.app n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hj)))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (i : ι), (δ.hom.app n).over (U i) =
        (ε i).hom.app n ≫ (((completion X J).map a).hom.app n).over (U i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj M ≅ (Fi i).obj,
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map a.hom ≫
          eqToHom (hHlocal i).symm = e.hom ≫ (ai i).hom)
